quest.title: Priorities First: Afterword
quest.description: A few days later, you return to Nasha Town...

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: I've never seen a Weasel Thief this white before. Do you think it might be ill...?

dialogues.speaker: Mikko
dialogues.text: It was full of energy just now — it even tried to snatch some food from Jurva. It doesn't seem sick to me!

dialogues.speaker: Jurva
dialogues.text: Maybe it's a rare species? Linnea might know.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! It's the Mora thief who emptied Paimon's secret stash!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Weasel Thief tries to run away, but the three kids are lightning fast. They pin it down, and after a short struggle, it gives up. You take the chance to explain what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Mikko
dialogues.text: So this isn't the first time it's done this? In that case, we've gotta teach it a lesson! Do something wrong, and you get punished. That's only fair, right?

dialogues.speaker: Maisie
dialogues.text: But... It's just an animal. It doesn't understand what's right and wrong...

choices.text: As long as it gives Paimon her Mora back, that's enough for me.

response.speaker: Jurva
response.text: Anyway, let's get Paimon her Mora back first. It's not like the weasel can spend it, so it should all still be there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay! Hehe, Paimon's secret stash is back in business!

response.speaker: Maisie
response.text: I wish we could keep it. That way, when Helka comes back, we can show her a rare Weasel Thief!

response.speaker: Mikko
response.text: Huh? But it's not like we can put it to work... Stealing doesn't count! Why should it get free food for nothing?

response.speaker: Jurva
response.text: Okay, okay, but what should we do with it...? Let's figure that out with Katya later.

choices.text: Even animals need to learn how cruel the world can be...

talks.objective: Go take a look around Nasha Town
